europe_now.title: Mass Protests and Unrest across French Cities
europe_now.summary: France has experienced widespread demonstrations resulting in over a thousand arrests and significant security deployments in major cities. Far-right leader Marine Le Pen launched her presidential campaign by attempting to leverage the ongoing unrest.

europe_now.title: Historic Electoral Defeat in Serbia
europe_now.summary: Longtime Serbian leader Aleksandar Vučić has conceded defeat following snap parliamentary elections marked by record-high voter turnout. The outcome followed intense public mobilization and student-led protest movements in the country.

top_stories.title: French Presidential Campaign Developments
top_stories.summary: Far-right leader Marine Le Pen officially initiated her presidential bid in Orléans while positioning herself as a national protector amid ongoing civil unrest. Meanwhile, recent polling figures indicated a shift in candidate standing among prospective voters.

top_stories.title: Political Transition in Serbia
top_stories.summary: Serbia experienced a historic political shift as high voter turnout characterized snap parliamentary contests. The prolonged political era concluded as the incumbent ruler formally acknowledged defeat in response to popular demonstrations.
